newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Pep Boys at outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Pep Boys at outperform.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it reiterated its outperform rating on Pep Boys -- Manny, Moe & Jack and its price targets of $41 for the six months and $45 for the 18 months.
--EVEREN repeated its FY98 earnings per share estimate of $1.98 and established a FY99 EPS projection of $2.40.
--"Although our FY98 estimate is at the high end of analysts' estimates, we believe earnings estimates will move higher over the next several months," said analyst Beth Richard in a report.
